AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.subtitle: Always on the student's side.
AboutPage.description: Two stories, one mission: Morgana and Orum join forces to transform the university into a place of opportunity, rights, and growth. Discover who we are and what we do for you every day.
AboutPage.alliance_desc: Since April 21, 2026, Associazione Morgana and O.R.U.M. have signed a historic strategic alliance. We combine our resources, expertise, and networks to offer you a unique portal, integrated services, and even stronger representation.
AboutPage.morgana_story: Morgana was born from the will of a group of students determined not to be simple spectators of their academic career. In a few years we have become a reality rooted not only in the University of Messina, but in the entire social fabric of the city. We are the energy that moves the university.
AboutPage.orum_story: Orum represents the evolution of student representation. Founded on foundations of seriousness and competence, the association has distinguished itself for its ability to dialogue at the highest institutional levels, obtaining concrete results for the improvement of teaching and student services.
AboutPage.morgana_commitment: We don't wait for things to change, we change them together with you.
AboutPage.orum_commitment: Your voice in the institutions, your security in the course of study.
AboutPage.morgana_activity_1_desc: We bring your instances directly to the Department Councils and University Bodies with courage and determination.
AboutPage.morgana_activity_2_desc: We organize workshops, seminars, and the famous 'Piazza dell'Arte', transforming the university into a living cultural center.
AboutPage.morgana_activity_3_desc: We believe in the value of the gift. With initiatives such as 'The Night of Gifts', we bring the support of students beyond the classroom walls.
AboutPage.orum_activity_1_desc: With our elected members in the Academic Senate and Board of Directors, we influence the decisions that matter, from taxes to teaching regulations.
AboutPage.orum_activity_2_desc: We support the student at every stage, from the first entrance test until graduation, ensuring that no one is left behind.
AboutPage.orum_activity_3_desc: We create bridges with the world of work through conventions and technical seminars that enrich your curriculum (CFU).
AboutPage.join_team_morgana: If you have passion, ideas, and a desire to get involved in the social and the territory, Morgana is the right place for you.
AboutPage.join_team_orum: If you want to influence institutional decisions and concretely support the right to study, join Orum.

economia.desc: Studenti Economia is the reference point for those who live in the Department of Economics. Passion, competence and a strong group spirit at the service of academic and professional growth.

piazzadellarte.subtitle: The beating heart of student creativity.
piazzadellarte.desc: Piazza Dell'Arte is the major socio-cultural event that transforms the University into an open-air stage.
piazzadellarte.desc_long: Mainly organized by the Morgana University Association, in collaboration with O.R.U.M. and Azione Universitaria, Piazza dell'Arte is one of the most anticipated events of the Messinese spring. The project values local young talents, offering them a free and participatory showcase in the University's Central Courtyard and on the Rectorate's Staircase.
piazzadellarte.schedule_morning: Artistic workshops, live painting, and cultural seminars (such as the 'Symposium').
piazzadellarte.schedule_night: Live performances by bands, soloists, dancers, actors, and performers.
piazzadellarte.fanta_desc: Become a virtual 'Art Curator'! Create your Gallery with 5 artists and accumulate points based on what happens on stage.
piazzadellarte.fanta_rules: You have 100 'Armoni' to compose your team. Bonuses for standing ovations and special awards; Penalties for delays or technical hitches!
piazzadellarte.associations_desc: A choral project featuring the Morgana, O.R.U.M., and Azione Universitaria associations, with the support of UniMe, ERSU, and numerous local partners.

Statuto.intro: The Statute is the fundamental document that defines our values, our structure and the rules of participation in associative life.
Statuto.motto: The Morgana and O.R.U.M. Associations were born with the aim of:
Statuto.p1: Representing the interests of students in all academic bodies of the University of Messina.
Statuto.p2: Promoting cultural, educational and recreational activities that favor the human and professional growth of the members.
Statuto.p3: Favoring the integration of new students (freshmen) and constant support throughout the course of study.
Statuto.doc_desc: You can consult or download the complete statute in PDF format by clicking on the button below.
Statuto.transparency_desc: Associative life is regulated by the principle of democracy and active participation. Every registered student has the right to participate in assemblies and contribute to the definition of programmatic lines.

Privacy.intro: Pursuant to Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), the user is informed of the following regarding the processing of personal data collected through the common web portal of the ORUM and Morgana Associations.
Privacy.data_controller_desc: Personal data is processed under joint controllership by the O.R.U.M. Association (C.F. 27068650833), represented by Luigi Grillo, and the Morgana Association (C.F. 97103490831), represented by Giuseppe Di Giorgio. The parties have entered into an internal agreement (ex art. 26 GDPR) to define their respective responsibilities.
Privacy.data_processor_desc: Mr. Massimo Mantineo is designated as the Technical Manager, in charge of the management, maintenance, and security of the IT infrastructure and database.
Privacy.data_types_desc: The portal collects the following voluntarily provided data: Personal identification data (Name, Surname, Date of Birth), Contact data (Email), Academic data (Student ID, Department, Degree Course), Logistic data (Resident/Non-resident status), and Technical navigation data.
Privacy.purposes_desc: Processing is aimed at: 1) Execution of the service (Legal basis: art. 6.1.b GDPR); 2) Direct Marketing and Communications (Legal basis: explicit and separate consent for ORUM and Morgana, art. 6.1.a GDPR); 3) Legitimate interest for statistical analysis (art. 6.1.f GDPR); 4) Compliance with legal obligations (art. 6.1.c GDPR).
Privacy.recipients_desc: Personal data will never be sold to third parties for commercial purposes. It may only be communicated to technical service providers (hosting, cloud) appointed as External Processors. Any transfers outside the EU take place in compliance with Chapter V of the GDPR.
Privacy.retention_desc: Account data is kept until a deletion request is made or after 24 months of inactivity. Event registration data is kept for 10 years for administrative purposes.
Privacy.rights_desc: The user can exercise the rights of access, rectification, deletion, restriction, opposition, and portability by contacting orum.unime@gmail.com or associazione.morgana@gmail.com. It is possible to lodge a complaint with the Privacy Authority.
Privacy.security_desc: Data is protected through encrypted HTTPS connections and strong password hashing, ensuring a level of security commensurate with the risk.

IniziativePage.title: Our Initiatives
IniziativePage.subtitle: Concrete commitment to the academic future.
IniziativePage.description: We work every day to improve student life at the University of Messina. Discover our interventions and achievements divided by thematic areas.
IniziativePage.didattica_desc: We ensure quality education and transparency in academic processes. By monitoring exam protocols, the timely publication of test dates, and compliance with teaching regulations, we protect students' academic journeys.
IniziativePage.aule_desc: We work to equip every department with welcoming spaces, study rooms with extended opening hours, and state-of-the-art laboratories to promote practical learning, group study, and social interaction.
IniziativePage.internazionalizzazione_desc: We support international mobility programs such as Erasmus+ and facilitate the integration of foreign students, promoting cultural exchanges and degree programs in English for a global university.
IniziativePage.trasporti_desc: We advocate for discounted urban and Strait ferry transport rates for off-campus students, the optimization of campus shuttle services, and the security of university parking lots.
IniziativePage.digitalizzazione_desc: We support the digital modernization of university services, monitoring Esse3 platform operations, promoting paperless administration, and pushing for stable and high-speed Wi-Fi in all classrooms.
IniziativePage.orientamento_desc: We support students from day one with free mock admission tests, freshman welcome days, and the organization of Career Days with local and national companies for qualified internships.
IniziativePage.diritto_desc: We oversee the distribution of ERSU scholarships, the reduction of tuition fees based on ISEE income brackets, and the provision of extraordinary grants, guaranteeing equal opportunities for everyone.
IniziativePage.attivita_desc: We believe in a vibrant university. We organize interdepartmental sports tournaments in futsal, basketball, and volleyball, recreational events, and the famous 'Piazza dell'Arte', highlighting student talent, creativity, and community.
IniziativePage.salute_desc: We prioritize the physical and mental well-being of students by promoting awareness campaigns, a free psychological support helpdesk, the active inclusion of students with disabilities or DSA, and healthy lifestyles.
IniziativePage.cta_title: Want to propose a new initiative?
IniziativePage.cta_desc: If you have an idea or want to report an issue related to one of these thematic areas, write to us immediately. The voice of students is our guide.
IniziativePage.major_subtitle: Our most popular and beloved projects throughout the academic year.
IniziativePage.cineforum_desc: Free film screenings inside the University, followed by group discussions on social and highly contemporary issues.
IniziativePage.cineforum_content: The University Cineforum is a historic initiative born with the aim of promoting cinematographic culture and offering students a space for debate and social exchange. Screenings are entirely free for the student community. Each cycle of screenings addresses a specific macro-theme (such as civil rights, contemporary history, environment, or social dynamics), guided by expert speakers and followed by classroom discussions where students can express their opinions and engage actively.
IniziativePage.piazza_desc: The large spring festival that transforms the university into an open-air theater with live concerts, dance, live painting, theater, and juggling.
IniziativePage.piazza_content: Piazza dell'Arte is the flagship event of our student associations. It is a highly significant cultural event for the city of Messina, now in its eleventh edition. For an entire day, the Central Courtyard of the University and the Rectorate Staircase turn into an open-air stage. The event hosts free performances by live bands, soloists, dancers, theater companies, and street performers, as well as live painting, artistic workshops, and photo exhibitions, offering space and visibility to hundreds of local talents.
IniziativePage.regali_desc: The historic Christmas solidarity drive to collect and donate toys to hospitalized or underprivileged children in the local area.
IniziativePage.regali_content: The Night of Gifts represents our main Christmas solidarity initiative, organized annually in close cooperation with the O.R.U.M. association and local non-profits. The goal is to collect toys, books, and presents to distribute to children hospitalized in the pediatric wards of the Policlinico di Messina and hosted in local family homes. Thanks to the generosity of students and citizens, every year we bring smiles and moments of carefree joy to hundreds of children in fragile situations.
IniziativePage.conferenze_desc: Meetings with experts, judges, historians, and academics to explore topics of legality, geopolitics, and culture, offering academic credits (CFU).
IniziativePage.conferenze_content: We regularly organize conferences, scientific seminars, and debates of high academic and cultural value. These initiatives cover central themes such as legality, geopolitics, contemporary history, and professional development, hosting judges, journalists, historians, and academics of national renown. Many of these seminars are accredited by the University of Messina, allowing participating students to acquire university training credits (CFU) for elective activities.
IniziativePage.sport_desc: Interdepartmental championships in futsal, basketball, and volleyball organized at the Sports Citadel to promote wellness and community.
IniziativePage.sport_content: Sports are a fundamental pillar for promoting integration and the physical and mental well-being of students. In collaboration with CUS Messina, we organize interdepartmental futsal, basketball, and volleyball tournaments at the Sports Citadel of the Annunziata Campus. The tournaments see the enthusiastic participation of hundreds of students every year, promoting healthy values of sports competition, team spirit, and socialization outside of lecture hours.
IniziativePage.svago_desc: Recreational events, freshman welcome gatherings, and social meetups designed to encourage integration and student community life.
IniziativePage.svago_content: We believe that university life shouldn't be about studying alone, but also relationships and community life. For this reason, we promote numerous recreational activities and leisure events, such as welcome aperitifs for new freshmen, board game tournaments, orienteering days, and social gatherings. These activities help students integrate, build new friendships, and fully experience academic life in a stimulating and inclusive environment.
